summary: Build a marketing website for DrawdownKing that presents the brand and highlights its purpose and offerings.
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Minimalist wordmark logo with crown motif, dark-on-light (drawdownking-logo.dim_512x256.png)
- Abstract financial drawdown chart hero illustration with bold shapes, warm palette (drawdownking-hero-illustration.dim_1600x900.png)
- Set of 3 simple line icons matching the brand style (risk, strategy, performance) (drawdownking-icons-set.dim_512x512.png)

existing_features.title: Create a responsive marketing website for the DrawdownKing brand with a single-page layout that clearly communicates the brand name, purpose, and offerings.

Implement a simple navigation and page structure suitable for a marketing site, including a header with navigation links (scroll-to sections) and a footer with basic brand and contact placeholders (no external integrations).
Add one cohesive, distinctive visual theme (colors, typography, spacing, and component style) and apply it consistently across the marketing site. Do not use a blue-and-purple theme.
Include basic on-page marketing elements: a hero section with a headline and short subtext, at least one call-to-action button, and an offerings section presented as a small set of feature cards.
Add generated static image assets for brand presentation (logo + hero illustration/background) and render them in the site from static paths (not via backend).

new_feature_requests.summary: Create a simple marketing website for DrawdownKing (brand/purpose/offerings)
